scripts.title: The Odd Day
scripts.script_md:
SCENE 1 · ITO crossing, morning smog

Kallu's taxi is stopped at ITO crossing on an odd day.

Kallu: Arre bhai, odd number aaj? Meri taxi to even hai!

Havaldar Sharma: Challan katega. Niyam niyam hota hai.

Kallu: Hawa saaf chahiye, lekin roti bhi to chahiye!

Scene direction: Kallu pleads with the constable, gesturing at his even number plate.
On-screen text: ODD-EVEN IS BACK
Audio/SFX: Traffic horns, distant siren
